name: Cat Calorie Calculator
description: Estimate a cat's daily calorie requirement from body weight and general life-stage or activity factor.
search_intent: Estimate daily calorie needs for an adult, indoor, active, weight-management or growing cat.
keywords: how many calories should my cat eat
calculation: Resting Energy Requirement (RER) = 70 × body weight in kg^0.75. Estimated daily calories = RER × selected maintenance/life-stage factor. Use conservative, clearly labeled factors for common non-clinical categories. Do not provide therapeutic feeding prescriptions or disease-specific calorie recommendations.
limitations: Individual calorie needs vary by age, body condition, activity, environment and health.
This tool is a general estimate and is not a veterinary feeding prescription.
Pregnancy, illness and medically supervised weight-loss plans require professional guidance.
